src.title: File:A Montagu's Harrier Taking Flight (51621854680).jpg
src.author: Hari K Patibanda
src.description: Sighted a pair of Montagu's Harriers roosting in the fields during our morning trip. Both were females and we found them in the fog on a farm post. They took off as soon we got a tad closer. These are migrant Harriers from Central Asia and this year they are quite early. Normally, we sight them beginning Oct end and in good numbers towards end Nov onwards till Feb. These Harriers are grassland hunters and hunt small birds, reptiles and large grasshoppers. Thanks in advance for your views and feedback.
